reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. Now, when you shape the ground—whether raising a lip or digging a ditch—the water responds accurately without causing frame freezes. This update enhances gameplay by ensuring that water depth is calculated efficiently, allowing for a smoother experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Provincia: Water Mechanics Update
steam.body: We're excited to announce improvements to water mechanics in Provincia! The latest update ensures that water depth reacts accurately to terrain changes, enhancing your city-building experience. Say goodbye to frame freezes when modifying the landscape. For more details, check out our dev talk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
